build_CentripetalHead: build a CentripetalHead instance with num_classes, in_channels, and loss config for object detection
init_CentripetalHead_layers: initialize the centripetal layers including deform convs, guiding shift, and centripetal shift branches
forward_single_CentripetalHead: run forward_single on a single feature level to get corner heatmaps and shift predictions
loss_by_feat_CentripetalHead: calculate detection, offset, guiding shift, and centripetal shift losses from extracted features
predict_by_feat_CentripetalHead: transform output features into bounding box results with optional NMS and rescaling
